help.title: Help & feedback
help.recordBody: Tap the “Add transaction” button in the center of the bottom bar, choose a category, enter an amount and select an account. You can also type something like “lunch 30” into the smart input on the Home page.
help.accountBody: Add bank cards, cash, e-wallets and other accounts on the Assets page, and assign every income or expense to an account to track your finances in real time.
help.statsBody: On the Records page, browse income and expenses by time and category to understand your spending trends.
help.backupBody: Export your data as a JSON file under “Data management”. After exporting, you can view, restore or delete backups directly under “Exported data” — no need to hunt for files.
help.faq1q: Q: Is my data uploaded to the cloud?
help.faq1a: A: All data is stored locally on your device and is never uploaded to a server. We recommend exporting backups regularly.
help.faq2q: Q: How do I move my data to a new phone?
help.faq2a: A: On the old phone, go to “Data management → Export data”, transfer the exported JSON file to the new phone, then use “Import data”. On the same phone you can also restore a backup directly from “Exported data”.
help.faq3q: Q: How can I recover a deleted record?
help.faq3a: A: Deleted records cannot be recovered, so please delete with care. You can export a data backup before deleting.

privacy.s1Lead: This app respects and protects your privacy. We
privacy.s1Tail: any personally identifiable information. All bookkeeping data (transactions, accounts, categories, etc.) is stored locally on your device and is never uploaded to any server.
privacy.s2Item1: Bookkeeping data is stored locally in the browser's IndexedDB and can only be accessed on this device
privacy.s2Item2: Exported data files (JSON format) are kept by you; we recommend encrypting them
privacy.s2Item3: Clearing app data or uninstalling the app will permanently delete local data, so please export a backup first
privacy.s3Item1: The app uses the network only for: checking for updates (GitHub Releases API) and downloading hot-update packages
privacy.s3Item2: Update checks send no user data; they only request version information
privacy.s3Item3: The currency converter uses an online exchange-rate API and carries no personal information
privacy.s4CameraBody: : used for receipt photo recognition (OCR); images are processed only on-device
privacy.s5Intro: This app uses the following third-party services; please refer to their respective privacy policies:
privacy.s5RateDesc: Exchange-rate API: used for multi-currency conversion
privacy.s6Body: We take reasonable technical measures to protect your data. However, no storage method can be guaranteed 100% secure, so we recommend exporting backups regularly.
privacy.s7Body: This privacy policy may be revised with app updates. Significant changes will be announced in the app. Continued use constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.s8Body: If you have any questions about this policy, please contact us via GitHub Issues.
